Name: Fish Again and Again
Author: KittyKaninka
Description:
The description of fish have been changed to show requirements necessary in order to catch them. 

For example, if a fish can only be caught in summer on rainy days, the description will say 'Is caught in summer, on rainy days'. 

If a detail is not written in the description, that means the detail is not important to catch the fish. Fx if a description does not mention which season the fish can be caught in, then the fish can be caught in all seasons.

Important: Legendary fish have not been changed.
The purpose of this mod is to make catching fish AGAIN easier, and the legendary fish can only be caught ONCE.

If there are any issues with the mod, spelling mistakes or incorrect information, please reach out so i can fix it.

Manifest.Name: Fishing Guide
Manifest.Description: Canges the description for all regular fish to how to catch them.
